messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate observed for inference-prod in az1a via proxy-eu-egress-proxy (p50 p95 p99 latency spike). Severity: P2. Paging oncall.
ryan (oncall): seeing it, joining. Can someone grab quick blast radius?
ana (eng-sre): I have dashboards open. 5xxs originate from proxy tier returning 502/503 to inference service, upstream connection resets to model hosts. Throughput steady but error % jumped to ~18% for last 3m.
bob (network): on it. Checking VPC NAT and az egress proxies for queue depth. Early look: proxy-pool-az1a has high tcp_retries and tx queue build.
meera (cust-success): flagged to a couple of affected customers: two mid-market customers report high error rate in production (customers: AlphaDocs, GuideFlow). ETA on mitigation? they asked for status.
ryan (oncall): prioritize mitigation: 1) divert traffic off az1a proxies if possible, 2) scale proxy pool in other AZs/regions, 3) apply temporary 429 throttling to heavy clients. Who can implement routing shift?
ana (eng-sre): I can initiate route shift. Plan: update smart-router policy to prefer eu-west1 then us-east1 for inference-prod paths for 15m, enable canary at 20% then 60% if stable. Command: 
```
# update routing policy
redwoodctl routes set --name inference-prod --prefer-region eu-west-1 --weight 0.2 --reason "egress-proxy backpressure az1a"
```
ryan (oncall): do it when ready. Also alert infra to scale proxy fleet in az1a as fallback.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: redwood/router:v2.4.1 -> rolling update started by ana (eng-sre).
bob (network): NAT metrics: SNAT connection table nearing limits on proxy hosts (conntrack > 90%). There's a burst of short-lived connections from model-loading jobs causing conn churn. I'm removing some iptables NAT conn timeout tuning to free entries. Applying: 
```
# temporary change
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
iptables -t nat -I PREROUTING 1 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```
ana (eng-sre): routing change applied at 20% now. Monitoring closely. Rolling increase contingent on p95 going down.
meera (cust-success): telling customers we're diverting traffic and investigating; logged incident number INC-7680012345. They want ETA ~15-30m.
jess (pm): are there queued model loads that can be deferred? If model host churn is driving conn spikes maybe gate it.
ana (eng-sre): yes, pushing a temporary gate: set MODEL_LOAD_RATE_LIMIT=0.5 for non-critical jobs. I'll add to deployment config on model-orchestrator.
ryan (oncall): any sign of node-level NIC errors?
bob (network): one proxy host shows tx_errors and netdev_tx_timeouts. Host kernel logs: "eth0: tx timeout" across a subset. Looks like NIC offload/dma issue exacerbated by conn rate. Opening host evac workflow. Marking 3 hosts for drain.
nana (eng-sre): draining 3 proxy pods from those hosts, kubectl commands: 
```
kubectl cordon node/ip-10-2-33-45
kubectl drain node/ip-10-2-33-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
nana (eng-sre): scaled proxy pool in eu-west and us-east by +30% as warm capacity.
ryan (oncall): good. Monitor error rate. If 5xx falls under 2% for 10m, we'll slowly revert.
nana (eng-sre): p95 dropped ~40% after routing shift to 20%, 5xx down to 9% at 5m. Increasing to 60% routing now.
meera (cust-success): customers updated — AlphaDocs confirmed errors dropping; GuideFlow still sees intermittent failures but improving.
nana (eng-sre): routing at 60%. p95 now near baseline, 5xx ~2.3%. Continuing to watch.
jess (pm): any customer-facing incidents or degraded SLAs to record?
meera (cust-success): recording incident impact: ~12 minutes of elevated errors with partial mitigation; two customers briefly impacted, no billing adjustments requested yet.
ryan (oncall): plan: 1) keep routing pref to eu-west1 for 30m, 2) finish host drains and reprovision suspect hosts, 3) roll kernel/network firmware patch on drained hosts overnight, 4) follow-up postmortem if root cause confirmed. Anyone taking handoff for next shift?
nana (eng-sre): I'm staying for another 25m then handing to night-sre. Will capture runbook actions in INC ticket.
bob (network): prepping a nettrace and will attach pcap+conntrack snapshot to the ticket.
nana (eng-sre): rolling restart of model-orchestrator gating done. No further model load spikes observed.
ryan (oncall): error rate stable ~1.8% last 5m. I'm marking incident as mitigated and moving to monitoring state. Oncall handoff to night-sre in 25m. Summary for handoff: cause likely NIC-level tx timeouts on subset of az1a proxies exacerbated by conn churn from model load jobs, mitigated by routing shift + scaling + host drains. Actions: follow-up kernel fw upgrade, tune conntrack, revisit model-load rate limiting.
meera (cust-success): sent customers a short note: "We diverted traffic and scaled additional capacity while we investigated root cause. Service performance is back to normal. We'll follow up with a technical summary." :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy completed: router policy updated, rollout successful.
ryan (oncall): handing to night-sre (alice) in 25m. tagging @alice. Any objections?
jess (pm): none. Thanks team.
nana (eng-sre): no objections. Saving logs and capturing metrics snapshot to INC-7680012345.
meera (cust-success): adding the customer timeline to the ticket.
ryan (oncall): closing Slack thread for live mitigation. Will open follow-up channel for postmortem later. Thanks all for fast responses. :white_check_mark:
